summary: Normalise P = tQ with t² = 1/(cν), so ⟨ρ(b)Pe_y, ρ(a)Pe_x⟩ = amplitudeSum(G(E), x₁, a⁻¹b, y₁)/ν. For each s, with U_s = R_s⁻¹(F) and A = F: dim U_s − ε − ∑_x‖ρ(1 − e)ρ(s)Pe_x‖² ≤ Re⟨dyad(ρ(s)P), dyad(A)⟩, ε = b⁻⁴columnDim bounding P*P − 1 (the off-𝖲 amplitude sums at 1). Averaging over s, Cauchy–Schwarz and the second moment with constant one (Θ(s) = energy at {s}, sum_le_of_positive_type) give ∑_s Re⟨…⟩ ≤ #𝖦·columnDim/2·(1 + 9b⁻⁴ + φ); and, splitting 1 − e into the single-prime terms, ∑_x‖ρ(1 − e)ρ(s)Pe_x‖² ≤ ∑_i (𝖲-trace + off-𝖲 rows of 1 − g_i) ≤ 4b⁻⁴columnDim. Hence dim U_s ≤ ((1 + φ)/2 + 19/2·b⁻⁴)columnDim for some s.

steps.claim: R = ρ(e), e = g₀ ⊗ g₁; fix F and φ; use the size facts of S.
steps.lean: set R := ρ.asAlgebraHom (piTensorElem g); intro F φ; apply S.of_size_bounds; intros

steps.claim: t ∈ ℝ with t² = (cν)⁻¹ (cν > 0); e is a central idempotent (IsCentralProj.piTensorElem); amplitudeSum(G(E)) = amplitudeSum(𝖲ᶜ) + amplitudeSum(𝖲) (amplitudeSum_split); each 1 − g_i is a central idempotent; P = t·Q.
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨⟨t, ht⟩, G, B, o⟩ := (isSquare_iff.2 (mul_pos hc S.unipCovolume_pos).le).inv,
    IsCentralProj.piTensorElem hg, S.amplitudeSum_split .univ (S.ratMiddle E).besselSᶜ,
    (hg · |>.one_sub); let P := t • Q

steps.claim: hu: ⟨ρ(b)P(e_y), ρ(a)P(e_x)⟩ = amplitudeSum(G(E), x₁, a⁻¹b, y₁)(x₂, y₂)/ν (unitarity moves ρ(a) across, then hQ and t²c = 1/ν).
steps.lean:
have hu a b x y : ⟪ρ b (P (.single y 1)), ρ a (P (.single x 1))⟫_ℂ =
      S.amplitudeSum .univ x.1 (a⁻¹ * b) y.1 (x.2, y.2) / S.unipCovolume := hρ a⁻¹ .. ▸ by
    simp [← End.mul_apply, ← map_mul, P, ← mul_assoc, ← ofReal_mul, ← ht, hQ, field, hc.ne']
steps.typed_fact:
⟪ρ b (P (.single y 1)), ρ a (P (.single x 1))⟫_ℂ =
      S.amplitudeSum .univ x.1 (a⁻¹ * b) y.1 (x.2, y.2) / S.unipCovolume

steps.claim: pr: for a central idempotent z, ρ(z) is self-adjoint (IsCentralProj.self_adjoint with the invariant inner product), so ⟨y, ρ(z)y⟩ = ⟨ρ(z)y, ρ(z)y⟩ ≥ 0.
steps.lean:
have pr {z} (hz : IsCentralProj z) y : ⟪_, _⟫_ℂ = _ :=
    (hz.self_adjoint ρ 1 (innerₛₗ ℂ) hρ y _).trans congr(⟪y, $(hz.1.map ρ.asAlgebraHom) y⟫_ℂ)

steps.claim: hb' i: Re(𝖲-trace of 1 − g_i) + ∑_a ‖off-𝖲 row_a of 1 − g_i‖ ≤ 2b⁻⁴columnDim (re_trace_besselS_le and sum_norm_amplitudeSum_le for 1 − g_i; Re ≤ |·| and a coordinate is at most the row norm).
steps.lean:
have hb' i := add_le_add (S.re_trace_besselS_le (o i) (hb i)) ((sum_norm_amplitudeSum_le i
    (o i)).trans' (sum_le_sum fun a _ ↦ (PiLp.norm_apply_le _ a).trans' (re_le_norm _)))

steps.claim: Some s satisfies dim U_s − ε − ∑_x‖ρ(1 − e)ρ(s)Pe_x‖² ≤ columnDim/2·(1 + 9b⁻⁴ + φ): sum over s of finrank_sub_le_re_inner_dyadSum (P_s = ρ(s)P, the operator ρ(1 − e), U_s = R_s⁻¹(F), A = F ⊆ V: for v ∈ U_s, ρ(s)Pv − ρ(1 − e)ρ(s)Pv = ρ(e)ρ(s)Pv = t·R_s(v) ∈ F; ε from sum_norm_amplitudeSum_le with i = 0 and the central idempotent 1), compared with the average bound of step 8 (exists_le_of_sum_le).
steps.lean:
refine (exists_le_of_sum_le univ_nonempty (g := fun _ ↦ S.columnDim / 2 * (1 + 9 * (S.b ^ 4)⁻¹ +
    φ)) ((sum_le_sum fun s _ ↦ finrank_sub_le_re_inner_dyadSum (stdOrthonormalBasis ..) (ρ s ∘ₗ P)
    (ρ.asAlgebraHom (1 - piTensorElem g)) (F.comap (R.rangeRestrict ∘ₗ ρ s ∘ₗ Q)) (F.map
    R.range.subtype) (Eq.trans_le ?_ (S.sum_norm_amplitudeSum_le 0 (.one_sub ⟨.zero, by simp⟩)))
    fun _ ↦ (⟨_, F.smul_mem t ·, by simp [P, R]⟩)).trans ?_)).imp fun s h ↦ ?_

steps.claim: The ε-hypothesis: (ρ(s)P)*(ρ(s)P) − 1 = P*P − 1 has entries amplitudeSum(𝖲ᶜ, x₁, 1, y₁)(x₂, y₂)/ν, since the 𝖲-part at 1 is ν·(identity) (amplitudeSum_besselS_one):
steps.lean:
· congr! 2; ext; rw [← basisFun_inner]
    simp [inner_sub_right, LinearMap.adjoint_inner_right, inner_single_left, hu,
      amplitudeSum_besselS_one, ite_div, add_div, B, apply_ite, S.unipCovolume_pos.ne',
      Finsupp.single_apply, MonoidAlgebra.one_def]; grind

steps.claim: computed on basis vectors (adjoint, inner products of e_x; grind).

steps.lean:

    simp [@norm_sq_eq_re_inner ℂ, ↓inner_dyadSum, apply_ite, ← Submodule.coe_inner, mul_pow,

steps.claim: k: ∑_y ⟨Pe_y, ρ(⊗_i(1 − g_i))Pe_y⟩ ≥ 0 (pr for the central idempotent ⊗(1 − g_i)).
steps.lean: have k := univ.sum_nonneg' fun y ↦ pr (.piTensorElem o) (P (.single y 1)) ▸ inner_self_nonneg

steps.claim: Expand: ‖ρ(1 − e)ρ(s)Pe_x‖² = ⟨Pe_x, ρ(1 − e)Pe_x⟩ (pr, unitarity, centrality); with the identity of step 11, ∑_x of it ≤ ∑_i ∑_x ⟨Pe_x, ρ(ι_i(1 − g_i))Pe_x⟩ (dropping −⊗(1 − g_i), by k), and each of these is Re(𝖲-trace) + (off-𝖲 diagonal) of 1 − g_i ≤ 2b⁻⁴columnDim (hb', amplitudeSum split by B).
The identity ⊗_i(1 − g_i) = ∑_i ι_i(1 − g_i) − (1 − ⊗_i g_i) in ℂ[𝖦] (for two factors: (1 − g₀)⊗(1 − g₁) = (1 − g₀)⊗1 + 1⊗(1 − g₁) − (1 − g₀⊗g₁); ring).
steps.lean:
show piTensorElem (1 - g ·) = ∑ i,
    piTensorElem (Pi.mulSingle i (1 - g i)) - (1 - piTensorElem g) by
    ext; simp [← map_one piTensorElem, -map_one]; ring, ↓@norm_sq_eq_re_inner ℂ, ↓hρ, columnDim,
    ↓pr G.one_sub, mul_add, mul_sum, @sum_comm (_ × _), asAlgebraHom_piTensorElem_mulSingle, B, (by
    simpa using congr(ρ.asAlgebraHom $(G.2.commute (.single s 1)) ·).symm),
    asAlgebraHom_eq_sum (ρ.comp _), by simpa using (hu · 1)] at *
